title: Barcelona Tour
text: We had a great time on our tour of Barcelona with Mr Singh He took us all through the city and many historic points of interest and even a few hidden gems I would definitely recommend this tour to everyone especially those who are interested in exploring the city for the first time
author: MarineMomNvyDoc

title: Barcelona night tour
text: Khan was excellent! He picked us up right on time. He was super knowledgable about the sights we toured and gave plants of time for photo ops.
author: Elsie_C

title: Barcelona after dark
text: We had a wonderful time seeing Barcelona after dark. There is a huge difference between the sites at daytime and nighttime. Our driver was very thorough and attend to what we wanted to see.
author: Sandra_W

title: A different perspective of tourist attractions.
text: Seeing the sights at night was pretty cool. They were all lit up beautifully and it was a lot less crowded with people and my photos looked different than the same ones I see in the daylight.
author: JenMakeupHair

title: The City is Different at Night!!
text: I used Welcome Pickups for initially Airport to Hotel Transport.  Then Saw they had the Night Tour of Barcelona.  We booked this and split the cost with another couple who were traveling on the same cruise as us.  The cost for 2 people or 4 was the same.             The Driver was outside our hotel and waiting for us.  Took us to the places we wanted to see and waited for us.  Took pictures that you normally don't get because you're on a Day time tour.
author: travelswithvic28

title: Great Sta
text: It was a great way to start our week in Barcelona. Really nice overview. And really nice chance to look at the city Christmas lights.
author: RussellR207

title: Great tour
text: Syid was our tour guide driver. Very friendly and knowledgeable. His Car was immaculate inside and out. Highly recommend the private tour. Better than being on a tour bus. Very relaxing and we weren’t rushed when stopping to take photos. Loved Barcelona!
author: 170reneew

title: Excellent experience
text: Christo was extremely polite, helpful and friendly. He gave us all the details regarding the sights we visited. He didn't rush us at any of the viewings and was extremely accommodating. Also, he provided us with good detail about the sights we visited. I will recommend him to everyone. Extremely well-mannered person. +++++😊
author: 908shwetai

title: Great opportunity to see the city at night
text:
Our driver, Naaem, was great. He has lived in Barcelona for 16 years, was clearly proud of his city, was very knowledgeable and friendly. He went out of his way to make sure we had a great evening. 

The tour gives you a great opportunity to see one of Europe’s most vibrant cities after dark. While the city itself does not have the beauty and views as Paris or Budapest at night, it’s still well worth seeing.
